description.value:
Impulsive, always active and impatient, Falcons live life at high speed. They hate waiting, whether for the comfort of others or imperative circumstances, and they always look for ways to streamline and hurry things along. They are competitive in the most carefree way and love to compete for ephemeral laurels that give them great satisfaction, before moving on to the next challenge. They live in the present, and tend to be bad strategists but excellent executors, although prudence is never their strength. In the military, they are sought-after and highly regarded as reconnaissance and raiders, often employed in quick guerrilla tactics. Unfortunately, their incredible agility and dexterity, especially in flight, sometimes gives them the illusion of being invulnerable. In their relationships, Falcons tend to be changeable and reluctant to make enduring bonds, which they perceive as too limiting, and anyone who wants to entertain any type of relationship with them must be aware of this trend. They love to travel, to experience new and exciting things, and they fear boredom and monotony more than anything else.

Increase in Ability Scores. Your Charisma score increases by 1 and your Dexterity score increases by 2.

Age. A Rapax reaches maturity around the age of 14 and is immediately considered independent. They have an average lifespan of around 60 years.

Speed.  Your base speed on the ground is 15 feet, and your flight speed is 40 feet.

Size. A Falcon can reach a maximum height of 4 feet and a weight of no more than 65 lbs. Your size is Small.

Wild spirit. You have proficiency in the Survival skill.

Feared. You have proficiency in the Intimidate ability.
